name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  apply exists_eq_left.2
  constructor
  apply updatedStatesInit
  exact InitStatesLength hi
  exact UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu
  exact InitStatesNodup hi
  cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu ▸ InitStatesUpdated hi
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  apply updatedStatesUpdate
  exact UpdateStatesLength hu
  apply updatedStatesDefMonotone
  exact UpdateStatesDefined' hu
  simp [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength hu, InitStatesLength hi]
  intro k hk hk'
  cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  ext x
  apply (inner_self_eq_zero' (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
  refine le_antisymm ?_ real_inner_self_nonneg'
  by_contra! hp
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hsub, hcomp, hsmooth, hrange, heq⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (hc.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hp))
  refine ((hsmooth.continuous.fun_mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hcomp.mul_right ?_ (mul_ne_zero (heq.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hp.ne')).ne' (by
    simpa only [inner_smul_right'] using
      hg _
        (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hsmooth, hcomp⟩ (contDiff_const (c := f x))))
  intro y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport φ
  · exact mul_nonneg (hrange ⟨y, rfl⟩).1 (le_of_lt (hsub hy))
  · simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy]

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (by decide)
  have hA2 := hA.of_le (m := 3) ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j : ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA2 t
  have hEd j := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j)
  have hB j := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A hA2 (j, i)
  have hdiv := congrArg (fun f => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i)) (funext fun y =>
    ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hdiv
  simp only [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j x)), _root_.sum_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, div_eq_mul_inv,
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t x), _root_.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul] at hdiv
  conv_lhs =>
    arg 1
    ext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    (((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun j _ =>
      (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (hB j) x t).hasFDerivAt).const_mul _).fun_sub
      ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
        hJd x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _)).fderiv]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, ← Time.deriv_eq, smul_eq_mul]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, 2, 2, j]
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hB j)]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out)]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hdiv, mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀ 𝓕.ε₀]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_sub, FreeSpace.c_sq, inv_mul_cancel_right₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let q := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let m := @mulLinearMap 𝓕
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂
    (f := (m.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF)).comp (m.flip q))
    (g := m.compr₂ ((ι.toLinearMap.comp (m q)).comp timeOrderF))
    (LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis fun φs' φs => ?_) a b
  dsimp only [m, q, LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
    mulLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  let t := (φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel
  let e := fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
  let l1 := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
      t ++
    List.filter e φs'
  let l2 := List.filter e φs ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      t
  have ht (l)
      (h : ∀ c ∈ l, e c) :
      𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ l ++ φs)) =
      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ l ++ φs) •
        ofCrAnListF (l1 ++ l ++ l2) := by
    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList,
      insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ φs' l φs h]
    simp only [l1, l2, t, e, List.append_assoc]
  trans ι (crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
    (ofCrAnListF l1 * q * ofCrAnListF l2))
  · apply congrArg ι
    simp only [q, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF,
      List.singleton_append, ofList_singleton, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
      ← ofCrAnListF_append, map_sub, map_smul]
    rw [ht [φ, ψ] (by simp [e, hφψ, hψφ]), ht [ψ, φ] (by simp [e, hφψ, hψφ])]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_sub, smul_comm]
  · have ht0 := ht [] (by simp)
    simp only [List.append_nil] at ht0
    simp only [map_smul, map_mul (@ι 𝓕)]
    rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
      (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc,
      ← ofCrAnListF_append, ht0, map_smul]
    by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ
    · simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, crAnTimeOrderSign,
        Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq,
        Algebra.mul_smul_comm, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul]
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic (Ne.symm hq), zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case app | tapp =>
    cases lc <;>
      grind (gen := 2) only [→ canonical_form_abs, → canonical_form_tabs,
        → Red.abs, → Red.tabs, → Red.appₗ, → Red.appᵣ, → Red.tapp]
  case let' | case =>
    grind (gen := 2) only [body_let, body_case, → canonical_form_sum,
      → Red.let_body, → Red.let_bind, → Red.case_inl, → Red.case_inr, → Red.case]
  all_goals grind only [Value, → wf, → Red.inl, → Red.inr, = Option.mem_def, = dlookup_nil]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case' red_I.par | red_K.par | red_S.par => apply _root_.symm
  case red_I.par | par.red_I =>
    obtain rfl := I_irreducible _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, ‹_›⟩
  case red_K.par | par.red_K =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hx⟩
  case red_S.par | par.red_S =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., by apply ParallelReduction.par <;> apply ParallelReduction.par <;> assumption⟩
  case par.par iha ihb e f ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx.1 hy.1, .par hx.2 hy.2⟩
  repeat' constructor
  all_goals assumption

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  exists _, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  constructor
  · constructor
    grind only [ChoiceBisim, → Bisimilarity.symm]
  rintro s t (h | h) μ s' ht
  case' choice =>
    cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  case choice.choiceR =>
    exact ⟨_, .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
    refine ⟨t', ?_, .bisim h'⟩
    try apply Tr.choiceL
    assumption

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let Y (g : C) := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  let S := (fun g => (Y g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  change (Y g).ncard = fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f at hg
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ steps h_i_add_steps
  have hr x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd := Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
    (s := {x | f x ≠ g.val x}) (t := Y g ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
    (fun x hx => ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    (by
      intro x hx z hz h
      obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
      exact (hr x).symm.trans ((congrArg₂ _ hq hk).trans (hr z)))
  simp only [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin,
    ←Finset.coe_filter_univ, Set.ncard_coe_finset] at hd
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps)
    (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  simp only [←hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul,
    ←Nat.sub_sub,
    pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
    pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at hb
  have hn := Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans hb)
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2).trans_lt
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 hn)

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hx := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff,
    Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at h hx
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    simp only [hx,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    ring
  · dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  letI : Nonempty F := ⟨0⟩
  refine Nat.le_induction ?_ ?_
  ·
    intro u hp
    have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u :=
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    refine hu ▸ hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) ?_
    rw [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
    simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
    assumption
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA MC u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e (by
      rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
      simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form] at hp
      assumption))
    apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
    intro r hr
    apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)    := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let v n : Set.Icc B T := ⟨u n, hB n⟩
  let f n := (v n, v n.succ, v n.succ.succ, v n.succ.succ.succ)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ := Finite.wellQuasiOrdered Eq f
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := exists_pos_add_of_lt hij
  have he : ∀ n ≥ i, f (n + c) = f n := Nat.le_induction h.symm (by
      intro n hn ih
      rw [Nat.add_right_comm]
      simp [f, v] at ih ⊢
      simp [ih]
      apply @Int.cast_injective ℝ
      simp only [hu, ge_iff_le, Nat.reduceLeDiff, Nat.reduceSubDiff, ih])
  exact ⟨i, c, hc, fun n hn => congr($(he n hn).1.val)⟩

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not.symm] at hPP hPS
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, Fintype.card_set.symm,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i)  := by
  intro d e f h
  have hd {a b} (hab : relation a b) (i) :
      7 ∣ digits_to_num a + (b i - a i) * 10 ^ i.val := by
    refine (congrArg (7 ∣ ·) ?_).mp (((hrelation a b).mp hab).2 i)
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Int.sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [← Int.sub_mul, ite_sub, Int.sub_self, ite_mul, Int.zero_mul, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd h.1 i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Fin.sum_const, Int.sub_mul,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num] at hs
  have hc : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := by decide
  intro i
  apply hc.pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  apply Int.dvd_add_self_mul.mp
  refine (congrArg (7 ∣ ·) ?_).mp (Int.dvd_sub hs
      (Int.dvd_add (hd h.1 i) (hd h.2 i)))
  ring
